# Green Light Studios

> Motion designer specializing in automation and modular asset systems, brand motion identity, and explainer animation. Built for studios and brands that need work that scales past the project it was made for. Based in Northern Colorado.

Green Light Studios is a solo motion design practice owned and operated by Alex Walsh. The studio builds intentional, hand-crafted motion graphics positioned explicitly against generic AI-generated animation. Alex brings a unique combination of motion design craft and a systems brain built from years in technical consulting and programming. Available for studio hire and freelance clients nationwide and internationally.

## Services

- Brand Motion Identity: Motion identities built to stop traffic and make brands impossible to ignore across every platform.
- Explainer and Concept Animation: Complex ideas translated into clear, memorable motion that makes audiences stop and watch again.
- Modular Motion Systems: Automated and modular animation assets built to scale across projects and campaigns.

## About

Alex Walsh holds a Bachelor of Fine Arts in 3D Graphics and Animation from the University of Colorado Denver, a certificate in Principles of Animation and Advanced Expressions in After Effects from School of Motion, and a certificate in Computer Programming from Colorado State University Global. Production workflow: Adobe After Effects, Cinema 4D, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and Premiere Pro.

## Geography

Primary service area: Fort Collins CO, Greeley CO, Loveland CO, Windsor CO, Longmont CO. Remote work available nationwide and internationally.
